sync-app-versions.description: Move the @ng-native packages each project's own package.json lists to the new version.

split-store-and-player.description: Import Storage, SecureStorage, audioPlayer and videoPlayer from the entry points that now hold them.

tracking-available-getter.description: Read Tracking's available as a property rather than calling it.

device-react-native-import.description: Note each import of reactNative or ReactNative from @ng-native/device, which no longer exports them.

engine-node-tag.description: Read an engine node's element tag as tag rather than name.

engine-node-fields.description: Read an engine node's children, text, kind, host and sheet by their new names.

library-typecheck-declaration-map.description: Turn off declarationMap in each Nx library's tsconfig.typecheck.json, which TypeScript refuses beside composite: false.

native-typecheck-target.description: Give each Angular Native project in angular.json a typecheck target, run by ngc.

stop-watching-conditions.description: Keep what watchConditions returns in each app's entry point and stop it as the app is destroyed.
